description: This file is a controller class for managing user addresses in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It handles viewing, listing, adding, editing, and deleting addresses, including form handling, validation, and session updates.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Controller class for managing user address pages in the account section of OpenCart. It includes methods for displaying address lists, address forms, saving updates, and deleting addresses.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the address management page, setting up data and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method to handle address list display, ensuring user validation.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Protected method that retrieves the list of addresses for the customer and prepares the data for the view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the address form for adding or editing an address, populating data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the submission of address data, performing validation and saving or updating the address.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer's address after validation, and cleans up session data.
